basic_profile.bio: Avid gamer and tech enthusiast, currently living in Tokyo, Japan. I'm a university student majoring in computer science with a deep love for retro gaming and modding. In my free time, I enjoy exploring new music genres like City Pop, and I have a keen interest in fashion, especially sneaker culture. I usually browse Reddit during the late evenings after school and gaming sessions. Single and enjoying the freedom to dive deep into my hobbies.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a strong foundation in computer science from my ongoing university education. My interest in gaming led me to explore emulation and game modding communities. I've learned a lot about modding through online forums and trial-and-error, particularly with games like Mario Kart Wii. My curiosity often drives me to experiment with new software and technologies.
